quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown addresses his comments regarding Jayson Tatum's trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: I didn't see the full thing, but I saw that he said, This is no beef, and I think he's right.
quotes.quote: I didn't see the full thing, but I saw that he said, This is no beef, and I think he's right. There's no beef. No, Jason comes from a wonderful family. We've accomplished some great things. He a hell of a basketball player. He got a great PR team. There's no beef, but, you know, it might be a little lamb chops and some gravy. You know what I mean? We should stay ready at all times. It should never, ever be at. It's just basketball. We both blessed. It might be a little lamb chop. We'll be all right.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum discusses his relationship with Jaylen Brown after trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: I don't have any animosity or beef or ill will towards him.
quotes.quote: I understand we in an entertainment business. Me personally, I'm not much of an off the court entertainer type of guy. And for me, it's like, you know, I don't have any animosity or beef or ill will towards him. And I think the frustrating part is since, you know, he's not on our, you know, with the Celtics anymore, the narrative or the conversations haven't been enough about what we accomplished, all the games we won, winning a championship, how we've grown together. And it's turned into this, you know, like drama type of thing. And it's like, I'm not like, it's not really like without like, I got two kids. You know what I'm saying? Like, I reached out to him the day he got traded. Like, I called him, I texted him. And I understand people process things differently. So for me, you know, like at this point in our lives, like we too old to be having, you know, our relationship discussed XYZ like on the internet.
